modeHintAuto: Auto: ANIMA uses the best engine available right now and walks down the ladder until one answers — online AI (if you have a key), your PC’s local AI, the model on your browser GPU, the browser brain with the web index, then the Cardputer.
modeHintPrivate: Private: the same ladder without the Internet — your PC’s local AI, the model on your browser GPU, the browser brain with only already-cached web cards, and the Cardputer. Nothing leaves your home network.
modeFieldSub: Whether ANIMA may use the Internet: Auto uses it when it helps, Private never does.
modeChain: Commands (time, reminders, volume…) go to the Cardputer first. For everything else Auto walks one ladder until an engine answers: online AI (with a key) → your PC’s local AI (Ollama, LM Studio) → the model on your browser GPU → the browser brain (WASM + web index) → the Cardputer. Private is the same ladder with every network step removed. Tap “ANIMA · …” at the top to see which engines are ready; /guide for the full map.
webPrivate: The 🌐 Web search needs the network — switch the mode to Auto to use it.
tutModeBullet: For online answers, weather and news keep the mode on Auto (⚙ Settings · Engine); Private never uses the network.

gpuFix_insecure:
To turn it on in Chrome or Edge:
1. Open {flag} (paste it in the address bar).
2. In the box type {origin}
3. Choose Enabled and press Relaunch.
gpuFix_browser: Use an up-to-date Chrome or Edge (version 113 or later) on a computer. Firefox and Safari have it only in their newest versions.
gpuFix_blocked:
How to fix it:
1. Browser settings ▸ System: turn on "Use graphics acceleration" and relaunch the browser.
2. Open chrome://gpu: next to WebGPU it must say "Hardware accelerated".
3. If the GPU is too old, the local model cannot run on this computer: use another one.

guideMinds:
ANIMA tries its engines in order, from the most capable to the always-there:
☁ 1 · Online AI — Claude/Groq/Grok/Gemini, needs a key and Internet.
⌂ 2 · Local AI on your PC — Ollama or LM Studio: free, private, and with the real tools (files, apps, the Cardputer’s state). With no cloud key it answers first.
✦ 3 · Browser GPU — a language model on your graphics card (WebLLM), once installed.
◆ 4 · Browser brain + web index — the Cardputer’s offline cascade compiled to WebAssembly and run on your CPU; when it doesn’t know, it looks the answer up on Wikipedia from the browser.
▣ 5 · Cardputer — the brain on the device, the final safety net. While you use the web desktop the Cardputer pauses it to leave the desktop the memory.
guideModes: Auto walks the whole ladder. Private removes every network step: no online AI, no live web search (only cards already cached); your PC’s AI, the browser brain and the Cardputer remain. Tap “ANIMA · …” at the top to choose and see which engines are ready, or type /auto or /private. Device actions — volume, reminders, the time — always go to the Cardputer first; when it can’t (web mode), your PC’s local AI carries them out with its tools, or ANIMA tells you honestly they were not done.
guideTeach: Say “remember that the meeting room is on the third floor” or “my name is Marco”. Personal facts are kept by the Cardputer, so every browser sees them; while the Cardputer is unreachable they wait in this browser and are handed over as soon as it answers.
guidePrivacy: In Private mode nothing leaves this machine and your Cardputer. With a key, online calls go straight from your browser to the provider — never through the device, never logged.
